title: Maximal Algebras of Block Toeplitz Matrices with Entries in the Schur Algebra
summary: The classification of maximal algebras of square block Toeplitz matrices is a considerably more difficult problem and has received relatively little attention in the existing literature. In this work, we approach the problem under the assumption that the entries belong to the Schur algebra. Within these settings, we obtain a complete classification of all maximal algebras of such block Toeplitz matrices.
